SchemaVersion.description: Keep at 1 for this package format.

SetupId.description: Stable package identity and state/mutex namespace. Letters, digits, dot, underscore, and hyphen; 1-80 characters.

SetupVersion.description: Change when you intentionally want a new setup revision. 1-40 safe characters.

CompanyName.description: Displayed next to the optional logo; an empty string hides the company text.

Message.description: Welcome text beneath the heading. Wraps automatically; keep it to a short paragraph.

LogoPath.description: Relative PNG/JPG/BMP path, e.g. Assets/company-logo.png. Empty hides the logo.

BannerPath.description: Relative PNG/JPG/BMP path. Empty hides the full-width banner.

BannerHeight.description: Banner region height in WPF device-independent units; 40-240. Sets the available area, not a forced image height.

LogoMaxWidth.description: Maximum logo width; 24-400. Aspect ratio is preserved.

LogoMaxHeight.description: Maximum logo height; 24-120. Aspect ratio is preserved.

BannerStretch.description: Optional. Controls image fitting. Uniform keeps the entire image and its aspect ratio; UniformToFill fills/crops; None keeps natural size; Fill may distort.

BannerStretchDirection.description: Optional. DownOnly prevents enlargement; Both allows enlargement and shrinking; UpOnly allows enlargement only. Ignored for Stretch=None.

IconPath.description: Optional package-relative ICO or PNG. Empty uses the built-in setup icon for the window, taskbar and Alt+Tab.

Theme.description: Light or Dark. The Dark-Demo.json example includes brighter accent/status colors for dark backgrounds.

AccentColor.description: Primary buttons, current-step spinner/border, and progress. Hex #RRGGBB.

WindowWidth.description: Preferred width; 640-1600. Clamped to available desktop work area.

WindowHeight.description: Preferred height; 520-1200. Clamped to available desktop work area; step list scrolls.

Topmost.description: Keep the window above ordinary application windows.

ReduceMotion.description: Disable spinner rotation. The Running state and progress remain visible.

ShowElapsedTime.description: Show total elapsed time and per-step duration.

FontFamily.description: Installed Windows font family. Segoe UI is the default.

RunningMessage.description: Status-panel supporting text while steps run.

SuccessHeading.description: Status-panel heading after all steps succeed.

SuccessMessage.description: Status-panel supporting text after all steps succeed.

WarningHeading.description: Heading when required steps succeeded but optional work failed/skipped.

WarningMessage.description: Supporting text for that optional-issue outcome.

Footer.description: Short instruction at the bottom of the window.

Support.description: Plain-text help/contact information. Does not launch an email client or browser.

SelectionHeading.description: Optional text for the pre-install selection screen.

SelectionMessage.default: Select any extras you would like, then start setup. Required setup runs automatically.
SelectionMessage.description: Optional text for the pre-install selection screen.

StartButton.description: Optional text for the pre-install selection screen.

SelectionFooter.default: Optional apps are unchecked by default.
SelectionFooter.description: Optional text for the pre-install selection screen.

SelectStepLabel.description: Optional text for the pre-install selection screen.

RequireSystemForLive.description: Default true. Live mode requires SID S-1-5-18. For a controlled local admin pilot you may set false in a separate config; this does not elevate the process.

ResumeCompletedSteps.description: Remember successful steps and skip matching work on later live runs.

StopOnRequiredFailure.description: True skips all remaining steps after a required failure. False continues independent work. Dependencies are always respected.

AllowRetry.description: Show Retry unfinished for failures/skips. Timeout/controller faults disable retry regardless of this value.

AutoCloseSuccessSeconds.description: 0 leaves the results open. Otherwise closes 1-3600 seconds after full success; does not auto-close warnings/failures.

PollIntervalMilliseconds.description: UI update interval, 200-2000 ms. Spinner animation uses WPF animation independently.

StateDirectory.description: Absolute local directory after environment-variable expansion. SetupId is appended. Default uses ProgramData; do not use a network path.

Id.description: Stable unique identifier; 1-40 letters/digits/underscores/hyphens. Also used in log filenames and DependsOn.

Enabled.description: False omits the entry entirely. At least one step must be enabled.

Description.description: Supporting explanation. User-selectable steps add a Choose to install suffix; automatic non-required steps add Non-blocking.

Script.description: Package-relative .ps1 path; must exist for enabled steps.

Parameters.description: JSON object of named PowerShell parameters supplied to the script.

TimeoutSeconds.description: Whole-step execution limit, 1-86400 seconds. Includes child installer waits.

SuccessExitCodes.description: Final worker exit codes considered successful. Default 0 and 3010.

RebootExitCodes.description: Successful codes indicating a reboot is required. Must also be listed in SuccessExitCodes.

Required.description: Controls whether failure blocks overall success. False alone still runs automatically. UserSelectable=true requires Required=false.

DependsOn.description: Array of earlier enabled step IDs that must complete successfully before this step runs.

DemoSeconds.description: Simulated step duration, 1-60 seconds. Ignored in live mode.

DemoFailFirstAttempt.description: Intentionally fail this demo step on its first attempt, then pass on retry. Ignored in live mode.

UserSelectable.description: Optional. True shows an unchecked opt-in choice before setup begins; requires Required=false. Enabled must also be true to offer it.
